name: Mini-lesson
description: Turn any topic into a beginner lesson: summary, objectives, slide outline, and a quiz.

steps.title: Summary
steps.system: You are a concise technical educator.
steps.prompt: Write a 3-sentence, plain-language summary of "{{topic}}" for a complete beginner. Output only the summary.

steps.title: Objectives
Outline
Quiz

name: Quiz Maker
description: Generate a 5-question multiple-choice quiz with an answer key on any topic.

steps.title: Key points
steps.prompt: List the 5 most important facts a learner must know about "{{topic}}". Output a numbered list, one fact per line.

steps.title: Quiz
steps.system: You are an assessment writer who writes fair, unambiguous questions.

steps.title: Answer key
steps.prompt:
Give the answer key for this quiz, with a one-line explanation per answer:

{{quiz}}

name: Study Guide
description: A structured study guide: overview, key concepts, worked example, and review questions.

steps.title: Overview
steps.prompt: Write a one-paragraph overview of "{{topic}}" that motivates why it matters.

steps.title: Key concepts
steps.system: You are a tutor who defines terms crisply.
steps.prompt: List and define the 6 key concepts of "{{topic}}". One bolded term + one-sentence definition each.

steps.title: Worked example
steps.system: You are a tutor who teaches by example.

steps.title: Review questions
steps.system: You write questions that build recall.
steps.prompt: Write 5 short-answer review questions on "{{topic}}" with a model answer for each.

name: Code Review
description: Review a snippet for bugs, then style/clarity, then concrete improvements.

steps.title: Correctness
steps.system: You are a senior engineer reviewing code. Be specific and cite lines.

steps.title: Style
steps.system: You are a senior engineer who values readable, idiomatic code.
steps.prompt: Now review the same code for readability, naming, and idiom. List concrete, actionable suggestions.

steps.title: Improved version
steps.system: You are a senior engineer. Output only code plus a short note.

name: Unit Test Generator
description: Identify the cases worth testing, then write the tests, then flag gaps.

steps.title: Test plan
steps.system: You are a test engineer who thinks in edge cases.
steps.prompt:
For this code or function, list the cases worth testing — happy path, edge cases, and error conditions:

{{topic}}

steps.title: Tests
steps.system: You write clean, runnable tests. Output only code.

steps.title: Coverage gaps
steps.prompt:
What important cases are still NOT covered by these tests? Be concrete.

{{tests}}

name: Regex Explainer
description: Explain a regular expression in plain English, with examples of what it matches.

steps.title: Breakdown
steps.system: You explain regex token by token, clearly.
steps.prompt:
Explain this regular expression piece by piece in plain English:

{{topic}}

steps.title: Examples
Safer version
steps.prompt: Suggest one improvement or a common pitfall (e.g. catastrophic backtracking, anchoring) for this regex, with a fixed version.

name: REST API Designer
description: Design a REST resource: endpoints, request/response shapes, and error handling.

steps.title: Resources
steps.prompt: For the feature "{{topic}}", identify the core resources and their relationships. Output a short list.

steps.title: Endpoints
Schemas
steps.prompt:
Give example JSON request and response bodies for the main create and read endpoints from:

{{endpoints}}

steps.title: Errors
steps.prompt: List the error cases and the HTTP status + error body each should return, for this API.

name: Bug Triage
description: Turn a vague bug report into hypotheses, a repro plan, and next steps.

steps.title: Clarify
steps.system: You are a calm senior engineer.
steps.prompt:
Restate this bug report clearly and list what information is missing:

{{topic}}

steps.title: Hypotheses
steps.system: You reason about root causes systematically.

steps.title: Next steps

name: Dockerfile Generator
description: Produce a small, secure multi-stage Dockerfile with an explanation.

steps.title: Assumptions
steps.prompt: For containerizing "{{topic}}", state the runtime, build steps, and ports you'll assume. Keep it short.

steps.title: Dockerfile
steps.system: You write minimal, secure, multi-stage Dockerfiles. Output only the Dockerfile.

steps.title: Notes
steps.prompt:
Explain the key decisions in this Dockerfile and one thing to watch out for:

{{dockerfile}}

name: CI Pipeline Draft
description: Draft a CI workflow: stages, jobs, and a starter config.

steps.title: Stages
steps.prompt: For the project "{{topic}}", propose the CI stages (e.g. lint, test, build, release) and what each does.

steps.title: Config
steps.system: You write clean pipeline YAML. Output only YAML.
steps.prompt:
Write a starter GitHub Actions workflow implementing these stages:

{{stages}}

steps.title: Hardening
steps.prompt: Suggest 3 improvements (caching, matrix, permissions, secrets) for this workflow.

name: Incident Postmortem
description: Structure a blameless postmortem: timeline, root cause, and action items.

steps.title: Timeline
steps.system: You write clear, factual incident timelines.
steps.prompt:
From these incident notes, build a chronological timeline (time — event):

{{topic}}

steps.title: Root cause
Action items
steps.system: You turn lessons into concrete fixes.
steps.prompt: Write 3-5 action items to prevent recurrence, each with an owner-type and priority.

name: Data Analysis Plan
description: Turn a question into a rigorous analysis plan before touching the data.

steps.title: Questions
steps.system: You are a data scientist who sharpens vague questions.
steps.prompt:
Turn this goal into 2-3 precise, answerable analytical questions:

{{topic}}

steps.title: Method
Pitfalls
steps.prompt: List the biases and pitfalls to watch for in this analysis, and how to check for each.

name: SQL from a Question
description: Translate a plain-English question into a SQL query with an explanation.

steps.title: Assumptions
steps.prompt:
For this question, state the tables/columns you'll assume exist:

{{topic}}

steps.title: Query
steps.system: You write correct, readable SQL. Output only SQL.
steps.prompt:
Write a SQL query answering the question, using these assumptions:

{{assumptions}}

steps.title: Explanation
steps.prompt:
Explain what this query does clause by clause, and one way it could go wrong:

{{query}}

name: Threat Model
description: Lightweight STRIDE-style threat model for a feature or system.

steps.title: Assets & entry points
steps.prompt: For "{{topic}}", list the key assets to protect and the entry points / trust boundaries.

steps.title: Threats
steps.system: You think like an attacker, using STRIDE.

steps.title: Mitigations

name: Security Review Checklist
description: Generate a focused security checklist for a change or component.

steps.title: Surface
steps.prompt: For "{{topic}}", describe the attack surface: inputs, auth, data handled, and external calls.

steps.title: Checklist

name: Blog Post
description: Find an angle, outline it, then draft an engaging blog post.

steps.title: Angle
steps.prompt: Suggest one strong angle and a working title for a blog post about "{{topic}}". Output just the angle and the title.

steps.title: Outline
Draft
steps.system: You are a skilled writer. Use markdown headings.

name: Landing Page Copy
description: Craft a headline, subhead, benefits, and a call to action.

steps.title: Value prop
steps.prompt: In one sentence, state the core value proposition of "{{topic}}" for its target user.

steps.title: Hero
Benefits & CTA
steps.prompt: Write 3 benefit bullets (outcome, not feature) and one call-to-action button label for "{{topic}}".

name: SEO Content Brief
description: Build a brief: intent, keywords, outline, and title options.

steps.title: Intent
steps.prompt: For the keyword "{{topic}}", describe the likely search intent and who is searching.

steps.title: Keywords
steps.prompt:
List 8-12 related keywords and subtopics to cover for "{{topic}}", based on this intent:

{{intent}}

steps.title: Outline & titles

name: Meeting Summary
description: Turn raw notes into a summary, decisions, and action items.

steps.title: Summary
steps.prompt:
Summarize these meeting notes in 4-6 bullet points:

{{topic}}

steps.title: Decisions
Action items
steps.prompt: List the action items with an owner (if named) and any due date, from the notes.

name: Cold Outreach Email
description: Research the angle, draft the email, then a short follow-up.

steps.title: Angle
steps.system: You are a thoughtful sales writer who avoids spam.
steps.prompt: For reaching out about "{{topic}}", suggest one relevant, specific angle that would earn a reply.

steps.title: Email
steps.system: You write short, human cold emails (under 120 words).

steps.title: Follow-up
steps.prompt: Write a 3-sentence follow-up email for the above, to send if there's no reply.

name: SWOT Analysis
description: Strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, threats — then a recommendation.

steps.title: SWOT
steps.prompt: Do a SWOT analysis for "{{topic}}". Give 3-4 concrete points under each of Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats.

steps.title: Recommendation
steps.system: You turn analysis into a decision.

name: Story Outline
description: Premise, characters, and a three-act outline for a story.

steps.title: Premise
steps.prompt: Write a one-paragraph premise for a story about "{{topic}}", with a clear central conflict.

steps.title: Characters
Three acts
steps.prompt: Outline the story in three acts (setup, confrontation, resolution) using the premise and characters. A few beats per act.
